scripts.text:
[Friar Patrick]
The peace of this world cannot last forever... The hands of Evil are reaching into the world again...
scripts.translation:
[修士 帕特里克]
这个世界的和平不会永远持续下去...邪恶之手再次伸向了这个世界...

scripts.text:
[Friar Patrick]
What brought you to this place?
scripts.translation:
[修士 帕特里克]
是什么风把你吹到这儿来的？

scripts.text: What is this place?
scripts.translation: 这是什么地方？

scripts.text: I want to enter.
scripts.translation: 我想进去。

scripts.text: About the Cursed Baphomet Doll.
scripts.translation: 关于附有魔力的巴风特娃娃。

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: What is this place?
scripts.translation: 这是什么地方？

scripts.text: I want to enter.
scripts.translation: 我想进去。

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Friar Patrick]
Huh... Don't you know? This is St. Capitolina Monastery where the Brothers who wish to become monks train and pray.
scripts.translation:
[修士 帕特里克]
嗯...你不知道吗？这里是圣卡普托琳娜修道院，是那些立志成为武僧的兄弟们修行和祈祷的地方。

scripts.text:
[Friar Patrick]
And this place is... What can I say... Yes. It's the grave of the Devil. Grave...
scripts.translation:
[修士 帕特里克]
而这个地方是...怎么说呢...没错。这是恶魔的坟墓。坟墓...

scripts.text:
[Friar Patrick]
The very place where the great Devil who once demolished this world is sleeping.
scripts.translation:
[修士 帕特里克]
这里沉睡着一位曾经毁灭过这个世界的伟大恶魔。

scripts.text: Tell me more.
scripts.translation: 告诉我更多。

scripts.text: Stop talking.
scripts.translation: 别说了。

scripts.text:
[Friar Patrick]
Baphomet... is the name of the Devil... I think you have heard of his name.
scripts.translation:
[修士 帕特里克]
巴风特...是恶魔的名字...我想你应该听说过他的名字。

scripts.text:
[Friar Patrick]
Numerous brave men and brothers have trained in this monastery...
scripts.translation:
[修士 帕特里克]
无数勇敢的男性和兄弟曾在这座修道院中修行...

scripts.text:
[Friar Patrick]
Under this gravestone in front of you... Baphomet is sealed.
scripts.translation:
[修士 帕特里克]
在你面前的这块墓碑之下...巴风特被封印着。

scripts.text:
[Friar Patrick]
But... As we speak Satan Morocc is marshalling his powerful magic in order to affect all life on this continent.
scripts.translation:
[修士 帕特里克]
但是...此时此刻，魔王梦罗克正在聚集强大的魔力，企图影响这片大陆上所有的生命。

scripts.text:
[Friar Patrick]
Baphomet also... has awakened and is preparing for his revival, into this world, by weakening the power of the seal through the power of Satan Morocc...
scripts.translation:
[修士 帕特里克]
巴风特也...已经苏醒了，并正在准备复活，通过魔王梦罗克的力量削弱封印，重返这个世界...

scripts.text:
[Friar Patrick]
Now... I'm looking for someone brave enough to reseal Baphomet in its shrine... as we once did many years ago...
scripts.translation:
[修士 帕特里克]
现在...我正在寻找一位足够勇敢的人，将巴风特重新封印在他的神龛中...就像我们多年前所做的那样...

scripts.text:
[Friar Patrick]
Anyone who fights for good will know, deep inside, that evil is threatening to conquer this world...
scripts.translation:
[修士 帕特里克]
任何为正义而战的人，内心深处都会知道，邪恶正威胁着征服这个世界...

scripts.text:
[Friar Patrick]
Train more and use your skills to protect the world from evil's looming presence...
scripts.translation:
[修士 帕特里克]
多加修行，运用你的技能，保护世界免受邪恶的威胁...

scripts.text:
[Friar Patrick]
Anyone who fights for good will know, deep inside, that evil is threatening to conquer this world...
scripts.translation:
[修士 帕特里克]
任何为正义而战的人，内心深处都会知道，邪恶正威胁着征服这个世界...

scripts.text:
[Friar Patrick]
Train more and use your skills to protect the world from evil's looming presence...
scripts.translation:
[修士 帕特里克]
多加修行，运用你的技能，保护世界免受邪恶的威胁...

scripts.text:
[Friar Patrick]
Do you mean you'll go to the shrine and reseal Baphomet?
scripts.translation:
[修士 帕特里克]
你是说你要去神龛重新封印巴风特？

scripts.text:
[Friar Patrick]
Party name is {0}...
Name of the leader is {1}...
Okay... I'll adjust the shrine's seal so that you and your group can enter.
scripts.translation:
[修士 帕特里克]
队伍名称是{0}...
首领的名字是{1}...
好的...我会调整神龛的封印，让你和你的队伍能够进入。

scripts.text:
[Friar Patrick]
Party name is {0}...
Name of the leader is {1}...
Umm... But it seems that there is a problem here... I'll check quickly. Please wait.
scripts.translation:
[修士 帕特里克]
队伍名称是{0}...
首领的名字是{1}...
嗯...但这里似乎有些问题...我会尽快检查。请稍等。

scripts.text:
[Friar Patrick]
You will see a sign when the seal has broken. Please wait until the sign appears...
scripts.translation:
[修士 帕特里克]
当封印解除时，你会看到标示。请等待标示出现...

scripts.text:
[Friar Patrick]
When you see the sign, put your hands on the gravestone... Then you can move inside.
scripts.translation:
[修士 帕特里克]
当你看到标示时，把手放在墓碑上...然后你就可以进入内部了。

scripts.text:
[Friar Patrick]
One thing that you should remember is... Anyone who enters this shrine will be cursed by Baphomet and cannot enter or leave while they are cursed.
scripts.translation:
[修士 帕特里克]
有一点你需要记住...任何进入这个神龛的人都会受到巴风特的诅咒，在诅咒期间无法进入或离开。

scripts.text:
[Friar Patrick]
And one more thing... In this cursed area, some skills, which are protected by outer physical power are prohibited by the effect of the seal.
scripts.translation:
[修士 帕特里克]
还有一件事...在这个被诅咒的区域，一些依靠外部物理力量保护的技能会被封印的效果所禁止。

scripts.text:
[Friar Patrick]
For example, the skills like ^0000FFSafety Wall and Assumptio^000000... So you'd better prepare before entering the shrine.
scripts.translation:
[修士 帕特里克]
例如，像^0000FF暗之障壁和圣母之祈福^000000这样的技能...所以最好在进入神龛前做好准备。

scripts.text:
[Friar Patrick]
Umm... I recognize your courage, but... I can't permit anyone to enter this place. I can only permit the leader of a party to enter first.
scripts.translation:
[修士 帕特里克]
嗯...我认可你的勇气，但是...我不能允许任何人进入这个地方。我只能允许队伍的首领先进入。

scripts.text:
[Friar Patrick]
Once the party leader is permitted, the rest of the party can enter. This is a rule of this monastery, so please understand.
scripts.translation:
[修士 帕特里克]
一旦队伍首领被允许进入，其余队伍成员就可以进入。这是修道院的规矩，请理解。

scripts.text:
[Friar Patrick]
It seems you have entered this shrine recently... You cannot reenter because Baphomet's Curse still remains. Baphomet's Curse disappears only after a certain amount of time has passed.
scripts.translation:
[修士 帕特里克]
看来你最近进入过这个神龛...因为巴风特的诅咒仍然存在，你无法再次进入。巴风特的诅咒只有在一定时间过去后才会消失。

scripts.text:
[Friar Patrick]
Umm... It seems that Baphomet's Curse has weakened. I can remove it now.
scripts.translation:
[修士 帕特里克]
嗯...看来巴风特的诅咒已经减弱了。我现在可以解除它。

scripts.text:
[Friar Patrick]
Haaaaaaap... Hocus Pocus Wingardium Abracadabra!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[修士 帕特里克]
哈啊啊啊...呼斯 波克斯 温加迪乌姆 阿布拉卡达布拉!!!!!

scripts.text:
[Friar Patrick]
Huu... It's over. Now that I've released Baphomet's Curse, you can enter again.
scripts.translation:
[修士 帕特里克]
呼...结束了。既然我已经解除了巴风特的诅咒，你可以再次进入了。

scripts.text:
[Friar Patrick]
Umm... You should train more to enter this dangerous place... You should reach at least Lv 75 to enter here.
scripts.translation:
[修士 帕特里克]
嗯...你应该多加训练才能进入这个危险的地方...你需要至少达到75级才能进入这里。

scripts.text:
[Friar Patrick]
Please train more and come again.
scripts.translation:
[修士 帕特里克]
请多加训练，然后再来。

scripts.text:
[Friar Patrick]
That is... the villainous doll that you are holding... Let me see it.
scripts.translation:
[修士 帕特里克]
那是...你手里拿着的那个邪恶的玩偶...让我看看。

scripts.text:
[Friar Patrick]
... ... ...

[Friar Patrick]
That's correct... I can feel Baphomet's evil inside... So, what will you do with the doll?
scripts.translation:
[修士 帕特里克]
没错...我能感觉到里面的巴风特的邪恶...那么，你打算怎么处理这个玩偶？

scripts.text:
[Friar Patrick]
It is just a dangerous and useless thing if you do nothing with it... I'll introduce someone who can help you... Do you want to see him?
scripts.translation:
[修士 帕特里克]
如果你不处理它，它只是一个危险且无用的东西...我会介绍一个能帮你的人...你想见他吗？

scripts.text:
[Friar Patrick]
Go to see ^0000FFRust Blackhand^000000 who is near the main building of the monastery... He will make this doll helpful to you.
scripts.translation:
[修士 帕特里克]
去见^0000FF拉斯特·黑手^000000，他在修道院主建筑附近...他会让你利用这个玩偶。

scripts.text:
[Friar Patrick]
Anyone who fights for good will know, deep inside, that evil is threatening to conquer this world...
scripts.translation:
[修士 帕特里克]
任何为正义而战的人，内心深处都会知道，邪恶正威胁着征服这个世界...

scripts.text:
[Friar Patrick]
Train more and use your skills to protect the world from evil's looming presence...
scripts.translation:
[修士 帕特里克]
多加修行，运用你的技能，保护世界免受邪恶的威胁...

scripts.text: This gravestone has a carving of a wicked devil with large horns. It arouses an ominous feeling.
scripts.translation: 这块墓碑上刻着一个长着巨大犄角的邪恶恶魔。它散发着不祥的气息。

scripts.text: Touch the stone.
scripts.translation: 触摸石头

scripts.text: Step back.
scripts.translation: 退后一步

scripts.text: It's cold to the touch. It doesn't respond.
scripts.translation: 摸起来很冰冷。它没有任何反应。

scripts.text:
[Friar Patrick]
To enter this dangerous place, you can't go alone. Come again after you join a party.
scripts.translation:
[修士 帕特里克]
要进入这个危险的地方，你不能独自前往。组建队伍后再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Friar Patrick]
It seems you have entered this shrine recently... You cannot reenter because the curse of Baphomet still remains.
The curse of Baphomet disappears after a certain amount of time after you entered.
scripts.translation:
[修士 帕特里克]
看来你最近进入过这座神龛...因为巴风特的诅咒尚未消除，你无法再次进入。
进入一段时间后，巴风特的诅咒才会消失。

scripts.text:
[Friar Patrick]
Umm... It seems the curse of Baphomet weakened. I'll clear the bad curse.
scripts.translation:
[修士 帕特里克]
嗯...看来巴风特的诅咒已经减弱了。我来为你解除这个恶咒。

scripts.text:
[Friar Patrick]
Haaaaaaap... Wingardium Leviosa Expecto Patronum !!!!!
scripts.translation:
[修士 帕特里克]
哈啊啊... Wingardium Leviosa Expecto Patronum !!!!!

scripts.text:
[Friar Patrick]
Huu... It's over. Now I released all of the curses on you. You can enter again.
scripts.translation:
[修士 帕特里克]
呼...结束了。我已经解除了你身上的所有诅咒。你可以再次进入了。

scripts.text:
[Rust Blackhand]
Who are you? What do you want me for?
scripts.translation:
[拉斯特·黑手]
你是谁？找我有什么事？

scripts.text:
[Rust Blackhand]
You're not a monk, then what do you want?
scripts.translation:
[拉斯特·黑手]
你不是武僧，那你想干什么？

scripts.text:
[Rust Blackhand]
Did you bring all of the ingredients?
scripts.translation:
[拉斯特·黑手]
你把所有材料都带来了吗？

scripts.text:
[Rust Blackhand]
kkk... You prepared the ingredients well. Why don't you leave it there and wait?
scripts.translation:
[拉斯特·黑手]
呵呵...材料准备得很齐全。你先把它们放在那里，然后等着吧。

scripts.text:
[Rust Blackhand]
Hmm... It's been such a long time since I last saw these wicked horns... kkk... Let me start...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯特·黑手]
嗯...好久没见到这种邪恶的犄角了...呵呵...让我开始吧...

scripts.text:
[Rust Blackhand]
It's done. You may be excited, of course. I understand...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯特·黑手]
完成了。你当然会很兴奋，我理解...

scripts.text:
[Rust Blackhand]
I don't accept complaints or A/S requests, so use it with care. I must go...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯特·黑手]
我不接受投诉或售后请求，所以请小心使用。我得走了...

scripts.text:
[Rust Blackhand]
Huu... You don't understand what I said. You cannot make anything with these ingredients.
scripts.translation:
[拉斯特·黑手]
呼...你没听懂我说的话。用这些材料做不出任何东西。

scripts.text:
[Rust Blackhand]
I'll tell you the ingredients one more time, so please gather them correctly.
scripts.translation:
[拉斯特·黑手]
我再告诉你一次材料清单，请正确收集它们。

scripts.text:
[Rust Blackhand]
^0000FFCursed Baphomet Doll, Magestic Goat, 30 Crystal of Darkness, 50 Fragment of Darkness^000000, and the most important, production cost is ^0000FF990000^000000 Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[拉斯特·黑手]
^0000FF附有魔力的巴风特娃娃、山羊头盔、30个黑暗的结晶体、50个黑暗的碎片^000000，以及最重要的，制作费用是^0000FF990000^000000 Zeny。

scripts.text: About the Cursed Baphomet Doll
scripts.translation: 关于附有魔力的巴风特娃娃

scripts.text: Stop talking.
scripts.translation: 别说了。

scripts.text:
[Rust Blackhand]
What?... Hmmm... Did you get the doll? You're pretty good, unlike your appearance...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯特·黑手]
什么？...嗯...你拿到娃娃了？你看起来不像，但干得不错...

scripts.text:
[Rust Blackhand]
Let me see... Needless to say, Patric must have sent you here to deal with the doll, right?
scripts.translation:
[拉斯特·黑手]
让我看看... 不用说，帕特里克一定是派你来处理那个娃娃的，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Rust Blackhand]
Cool... I'll help you make the evil doll useful. What? What can I do?
scripts.translation:
[拉斯特·黑手]
酷... 我会帮你把那个邪恶的娃娃变得有用。什么？我能做什么？

scripts.text:
[Rust Blackhand]
I can make the strong and large horns of the wicked devil Baphomet for you. A helm that has his immense power.
scripts.translation:
[拉斯特·黑手]
我可以为你打造邪恶恶魔巴风特那强壮而巨大的角。一顶蕴含着他巨大力量的头盔。

scripts.text:
[Rust Blackhand]
It is called the ^4d4dffGigantic Magestic Goat^000000. You'll realize that the Magestic Goat you're familiar with is nothing in comparison.
scripts.translation:
[拉斯特·黑手]
它被称为^4d4dff巨大山羊头盔^000000。你会意识到，你熟悉的山羊头盔与之相比简直微不足道。

scripts.text:
[Rust Blackhand]
The Cursed Baphomet Doll is the most important ingredient... I'll make you if you want. What would you like to do?
scripts.translation:
[拉斯特·黑手]
附有魔力的巴风特娃娃是最重要的材料... 如果你想要，我可以为你制作。你想怎么做？

scripts.text: I want to make one!
scripts.translation: 我想制作一个！

scripts.text: I don't need one.
scripts.translation: 我不需要。

scripts.text:
[Rust Blackhand]
kkk... Yes, wise men take their chances when the opportunity comes. I'll tell you the ingredients. Don't forget, and bring them all.
scripts.translation:
[拉斯特·黑手]
呵呵... 是的，智者会在机会来临时抓住机遇。我会告诉你材料清单。别忘了，把它们都带过来。

scripts.text:
[Rust Blackhand]
^0000FFCursed Baphomet Doll, Magestic Goat, 30 Crystal of Darkness, 50 Fragment of Darkness^000000, and the most important, production cost is ^0000FF990000^000000 Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[拉斯特·黑手]
^0000FF附有魔力的巴风特娃娃、山羊头盔、30个黑暗的结晶体、50个黑暗的碎片^000000，以及最重要的，制作费用是^0000FF990000^000000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Rust Blackhand]
You can get the Magestic Goat from the weak Baphomet in the Labyrinth Forest. Crystal of Darkness and Fragment of Darkness are from the Incarnation of Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[拉斯特·黑手]
你可以从迷宫森林中较弱的巴风特那里获得山羊头盔。黑暗的结晶体和黑暗的碎片则来自梦罗克分身。

scripts.text:
[Rust Blackhand]
I'm sure that you can get the ingredients because you sealed the real Baphomet. Can't you? kkk...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯特·黑手]
既然你封印了真正的巴风特，我相信你能收集到材料。不是吗？呵呵...

scripts.text:
[Rust Blackhand]
You'll never know how great this hat is until you get one. If you understood, go and get the ingredients.
scripts.translation:
[拉斯特·黑手]
直到你拥有它，你才会知道这顶帽子有多棒。如果你明白了，就去收集材料吧。

scripts.text:
[Rust Blackhand]
Huh... Do you? Do whatever you want... Do you really want to let this opportunity go to waste?
scripts.translation:
[拉斯特·黑手]
哈... 是吗？随你便... 你真的想浪费这个机会吗？

scripts.text:
[Rust Blackhand]
Tut, tut... I don't care if the wicked doll threatens your life all the time!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯特·黑手]
啧，啧... 我才不在乎那个邪恶的娃娃是否时刻威胁着你的生命呢！

scripts.text:
[Rust Blackhand]
What a dull boy he is... huh...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯特·黑手]
真是个迟钝的男孩... 哈...

scripts.text:
[Rust Blackhand]
If you don't have business with me, go away! As you see, I make equipment for the Brothers at the monastery, not for adventurers like you. Do you understand?
scripts.translation:
[拉斯特·黑手]
如果你没有事找我，就走吧！正如你所见，我为修道院的兄弟们制作装备，而不是为你这样的冒险者。你明白了吗？

scripts.text: About the Cursed Baphomet Doll
scripts.translation: 关于附有魔力的巴风特娃娃

scripts.text: Stop talking.
scripts.translation: 别说了。

scripts.text:
[Rust Blackhand]
What?... You again? What do you want this time?
scripts.translation:
[拉斯特·黑手]
什么？... 又是你？这次你想干什么？

scripts.text:
[Rust Blackhand]
What? You got another doll from the wicked devil? Umm... You're much better than I thought...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯特·黑手]
什么？你又从邪恶的恶魔那里得到了一个娃娃？嗯... 你比我想象的要厉害得多...

scripts.text:
[Rust Blackhand]
Alright... I'll help you again.
scripts.translation:
[拉斯特·黑手]
好吧... 我会再次帮你的。

scripts.text:
[Rust Blackhand]
If you want to make the doll into a ^4d4dffGigantic Magestic Goat^000000 again, I can make you another.
scripts.translation:
[拉斯特·黑手]
如果你还想把娃娃变成^4d4dff巨大山羊头盔^000000，我可以再为你制作一个。

scripts.text:
[Rust Blackhand]
I'll tell you the ingredients again. So, do you want to make?
scripts.translation:
[拉斯特·黑手]
我再告诉你一次材料清单。那么，你想制作吗？

scripts.text: I want.
scripts.translation: 我想制作。

scripts.text: No, I don't want.
scripts.translation: 不，我不想。

scripts.text:
[Rust Blackhand]
kkk... Yes, wise men take their chances when the opportunity comes. I'll tell you the ingredients. Don't forget, and bring them all.
scripts.translation:
[拉斯特·黑手]
呵呵... 是的，智者会在机会来临时抓住机遇。我会告诉你材料清单。别忘了，把它们都带过来。

scripts.text:
[Rust Blackhand]
^0000FFCursed Baphomet Doll, Magestic Goat, 30 Crystal of Darkness, 50 Fragment of Darkness^000000, and the most important, production cost is ^0000FF990000^000000 Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[拉斯特·黑手]
^0000FF附有魔力的巴风特娃娃、山羊头盔、30个黑暗的结晶体、50个黑暗的碎片^000000，以及最重要的，制作费用是^0000FF990000^000000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Rust Blackhand]
You can get the Magestic Goat from the weak Baphomet in the Labyrinth Forest. Crystal of Darkness and Fragment of Darkness are from the Incarnation of Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[拉斯特·黑手]
你可以从迷宫森林中较弱的巴风特那里获得山羊头盔。黑暗的结晶体和黑暗的碎片则来自梦罗克分身。

scripts.text:
[Rust Blackhand]
I'm sure that you can get the ingredients because you sealed the real Baphomet. Can't you? kkk...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯特·黑手]
既然你封印了真正的巴风特，我相信你能收集到材料。不是吗？呵呵...

scripts.text:
[Rust Blackhand]
You'll never know how great this hat is until you get one. If you understood, go and get the ingredients.
scripts.translation:
[拉斯特·黑手]
直到你拥有它，你才会知道这顶帽子有多棒。如果你明白了，就去收集材料吧。

scripts.text:
[Rust Blackhand]
Huh... Do you? Do whatever you want... Do you really want to let this opportunity go to waste?
scripts.translation:
[拉斯特·黑手]
哈... 是吗？随你便... 你真的想浪费这个机会吗？

scripts.text:
[Rust Blackhand]
Tut, tut... I don't care if the wicked doll threatens your life all the time!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯特·黑手]
啧，啧... 我才不在乎那个邪恶的娃娃是否时刻威胁着你的生命呢！

scripts.text:
[Rust Blackhand]
What a dull boy he is... huh...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯特·黑手]
真是个迟钝的男孩... 哈...

scripts.text:
[Rust Blackhand]
Why are you hanging around here? If you don't want a ^4d4dffGigantic Magestic Goat^000000, go away.
scripts.translation:
[拉斯特·黑手]
你在这里徘徊什么？如果你不想要^4d4dff巨大山羊头盔^000000，就赶紧滚开。

scripts.text: The gravestone is trembling...
scripts.translation: 墓碑正在颤抖...

scripts.text: When touching the gravestone, I hear a voice.
scripts.translation: 触摸墓碑时，我听到了一个声音。

scripts.text:
[Voice of the Gravestone]
I have waited and waited for a brave adventurer like you who will come back here again...
scripts.translation:
[墓碑之声]
我等待了很久很久，等待像你这样勇敢的冒险者再次回到这里...

scripts.text: Who are you?
scripts.translation: 你是谁？

scripts.text: Waited for me?
scripts.translation: 等我？

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Voice of the Gravestone]
I was one of the warriors to stop Baphomet like you. Now, I'm dead and only my soul remains...
scripts.translation:
[墓碑之声]
我曾经是像你们一样阻止巴风特的战士之一。现在，我已经死了，只剩下灵魂...

scripts.text:
[Voice of the Gravestone]
As you know... We don't have much time. You can't stop Baphomet by yourselves. The power of the devil has strengthened over the years.
scripts.translation:
[墓碑之声]
正如你所知... 我们没有多少时间了。你们无法独自阻止巴风特。多年来，恶魔的力量已经增强了。

scripts.text:
[Voice of the Gravestone]
In the past, my companions and I sealed Baphomet at the altar located on the 2nd basement and blocked the entrance.
scripts.translation:
[墓碑之声]
过去，我和我的同伴们在位于第二层地下室的祭坛封印了巴风特，并封锁了入口。

scripts.text:
[Voice of the Gravestone]
I moved my soul's essence to my pendant, so that I could remain in this world. That's when I became this grave's guardian.
scripts.translation:
[墓碑之声]
我将灵魂的精华转移到了我的吊坠上，以便留在这个世界。那时，我成为了这座坟墓的守护者。

scripts.text:
[Voice of the Gravestone]
Baphomet's power is about to break the seal that we made. If you don't reactivate them... Baphomet's revival will only be a matter of time.
scripts.translation:
[墓碑之声]
巴风特的力量即将打破我们设置的封印。如果你不重新激活它们... 巴风特的复活只是时间问题。

scripts.text:
[Voice of the Gravestone]
To open the entrance, you must substantialize my soul. I'll open the entrance and reactivate the weakened seals after I am substantilized.
scripts.translation:
[墓碑之声]
要打开入口，你必须实体化我的灵魂。在我被实体化后，我会打开入口并重新激活那些衰弱的封印。

scripts.text:
[Voice of the Gravestone]
To substantialize my soul, you should find my pendant. You can find my body near a grave here.
scripts.translation:
[墓碑之声]
要实体化我的灵魂，你需要找到我的吊坠。你可以在这里的坟墓附近找到我的身体。

scripts.text:
[Voice of the Gravestone]
If your ^0000FFparty leader^000000 brings me the pendant, my soul can be substantialized. So, hurry up.
scripts.translation:
[墓碑之声]
如果^0000FF队伍首领^000000把吊坠带给我，我的灵魂就可以实体化了。所以，快点吧。

scripts.text: I can feel the voice becoming faint.
scripts.translation: 我感觉那个声音变得微弱了。

scripts.text:
[Voice of the Gravestone]
To open the entrance, you must substantialize my soul. I'll open the entrance and reactivate the weakened seals after I am substantilized.
scripts.translation:
[墓碑之声]
要打开入口，你必须实体化我的灵魂。在我被实体化后，我会打开入口并重新激活那些衰弱的封印。

scripts.text:
[Voice of the Gravestone]
To substantialize my soul, you should find my pendant. You can find my body near a grave here.
scripts.translation:
[墓碑之声]
要实体化我的灵魂，你需要找到我的吊坠。你可以在这里的坟墓附近找到我的身体。

scripts.text:
[Voice of the Gravestone]
If your ^0000FFparty leader^000000 brings me the pendant, my soul can be substantialized. So, hurry up.
scripts.translation:
[墓碑之声]
如果^0000FF队伍首领^000000把吊坠带给我，我的灵魂就可以实体化了。所以，快点吧。

scripts.text:
[Voice of the Gravestone]
Did you find the pendant?
scripts.translation:
[墓碑之声]
你找到吊坠了吗？

scripts.text:
[Voice of the Gravestone]
Yes... This is... My pendant...
scripts.translation:
[墓碑之声]
是的... 这是... 我的吊坠...

scripts.text:
[Voice of the Gravestone]
Now I can substantialize my soul. I'll wait for you in front of the altar of fire located at the center of this grave. Let's meet there.
scripts.translation:
[墓碑之声]
现在我可以实体化我的灵魂了。我会在这座坟墓中心的火祭坛前等你。我们在那里见。

scripts.text: I can feel the voice becoming faint.
scripts.translation: 我感觉那个声音变得微弱了。

scripts.text:
[Voice of the Gravestone]
Are you still there? Bring back my pendant as soon as possible.
scripts.translation:
[墓碑之声]
你还在吗？请尽快把我的吊坠带回来。

scripts.text:
[Voice of the Gravestone]
You can find my body near a grave here. Go and get my pendant there.
scripts.translation:
[墓碑之声]
我的遗体就在附近的坟墓旁。去那里把我的吊坠取回来。

scripts.text:
[Voice of the Gravestone]
I want to talk to ^0000FFa representative among your party^000000. Everyone else, wait here.
scripts.translation:
[墓碑之声]
我想和^0000FF队伍中的代表^000000谈谈。其他人请在这里等候。

scripts.text: 'Krrrr... Krrrr...'
I can feel something odd at the grave. It's like someone is calling out silently...
scripts.translation: 我在坟墓处感到有些异样。就像有人在无声地呼唤...

scripts.text:
[Ancient Hero's Soul]
With your help, my soul can be substantialized. I want to talk more, but we do not have enough time...
scripts.translation:
[远古英雄之魂]
多亏你的帮助，我的灵魂得以实体化。我想再多说几句，但我们时间不多了...

scripts.text:
[Ancient Hero's Soul]
I must be substantialized within the next hour. To reach the Main Altar underground, you must help me perform the ceremony for opening each seal.
scripts.translation:
[远古英雄之魂]
我必须在接下来的一小时内完成实体化。要到达地下的主祭坛，你必须帮我举行仪式，解开每一道封印。

scripts.text:
[Ancient Hero's Soul]
Now I'll tell you what should you do. First, collect ^0000FFEssence of Fire^000000 from the torches on the graves...
scripts.translation:
[远古英雄之魂]
现在我来告诉你该怎么做。首先，从坟墓上的火炬中收集^0000FF战神的精魄^000000...

scripts.text:
[Ancient Hero's Soul]
Second, all members who will enter the underground must carry a symbol, called the Token of Apostle.
scripts.translation:
[远古英雄之魂]
其次，所有进入地下的成员都必须携带一种名为“门徒的标示”的符号。

scripts.text: What is Essence of Fire?
scripts.translation: 什么是战神的精魄？

scripts.text: What is a Token of Apostle?
scripts.translation: 什么是门徒的标示？

scripts.text: What should I do?
scripts.translation: 我该做什么？

scripts.text: I am ready.
scripts.translation: 我准备好了。

scripts.text:
[Ancient Hero's Soul]
You can see the torches here and there. These torches are the essence of Thor, the god of Thunder. They are inherited from our predecessors to stop the darkness of Baphomet...
scripts.translation:
[远古英雄之魂]
你可以看到这里到处都有火炬。这些火炬蕴含着雷神托尔的精魄。它们是从我们的前辈那里传承下来的，用来阻止巴风特的黑暗...

scripts.text:
[Ancient Hero's Soul]
To open the sealed underground gate, I must be purified by the ^0000FFEssence of Fire^000000 which has the power of Thor. Collect ^0000FF10 Essence of Fire^000000 from the torches.
scripts.translation:
[远古英雄之魂]
为了打开被封印的地下大门，我必须被拥有托尔之力的^0000FF战神的精魄^000000净化。请从火炬中收集^0000FF10个战神的精魄^000000。

scripts.text:
[Ancient Hero's Soul]
One thing you must remember is... ^0000FFEssence of Fire^000000 can only be collected by the Inheritor of Faith.
scripts.translation:
[远古英雄之魂]
有一点你必须记住... ^0000FF战神的精魄^000000只能由“信任的继承者”收集。

scripts.text:
[Ancient Hero's Soul]
I'll give the token of the Inheritor of Faith to the party leader. Only the party leader can collect the ^0000FFEssence of Fire^000000.
scripts.translation:
[远古英雄之魂]
我会将“信任的继承者”的标示交给队伍首领。只有队伍首领才能收集^0000FF战神的精魄^000000。

scripts.text:
[Ancient Hero's Soul]
At that time, it was impossible to get rid of Devil Baphomet by ourselves. After numerous heroes sacrificed their lives, we could barely seal him under this Abbey.
scripts.translation:
[远古英雄之魂]
当时，我们无法独自摆脱恶魔巴风特。在无数英雄牺牲生命后，我们才勉强将他封印在这座修道院之下。

scripts.text:
[Ancient Hero's Soul]
However, Baphomet never gave up. He continuously strengthened his power. And his power has brought new life to this shrine.
scripts.translation:
[远古英雄之魂]
然而，巴风特从未放弃。他不断壮大自己的力量。而他的力量赋予了这座神龛新的生命。

scripts.text:
[Ancient Hero's Soul]
Some of these monsters have magical powers. Baphomet calls them his 'Apostles'.
scripts.translation:
[远古英雄之魂]
这里的一些魔物拥有魔法力量。巴风特称它们为他的“门徒”。

scripts.text:
[Ancient Hero's Soul]
The apostles are cloning themselves to fill the shrine with their evil energy. They are the monsters here in this catacomb.
scripts.translation:
[远古英雄之魂]
门徒们通过自我复制，用邪恶的能量填满这座神龛。它们就是这座地下墓穴中的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Ancient Hero's Soul]
Kill the Apostles. They can only be distinguished from their clones because they will possess a ^0000FFToken of Apostle^000000...
scripts.translation:
[远古英雄之魂]
击杀门徒。它们只能凭借持有^0000FF门徒的标示^000000来与克隆体区分开来...

scripts.text:
[Ancient Hero's Soul]
If each party member possesses a ^0000FFToken of Apostle^000000, Baphomet will not be able to perceive your entrance to the Main Altar underground.
scripts.translation:
[远古英雄之魂]
如果队伍中每位成员都持有^0000FF门徒的标示^000000，巴风特就无法察觉你们进入地下的主祭坛。

scripts.text:
[Ancient Hero's Soul]
If Baphomet perceives you when you pass through the sealed gate, he may release his tremendous magical power. Then, this abbey will be demolished.
scripts.translation:
[远古英雄之魂]
如果巴风特在你们通过封印之门时察觉到了你们，他可能会释放强大的魔力。届时，这座修道院将被摧毁。

scripts.text:
[Ancient Hero's Soul]
Kill the apostles and get the ^0000FFToken of Apostle^000000.
scripts.translation:
[远古英雄之魂]
击杀门徒并获取^0000FF门徒的标示^000000。

scripts.text:
[Ancient Hero's Soul]
You look like the leader of this party. You need to go and get ^0000FF10 Essence of Fire^000000 from the torches.
scripts.translation:
[远古英雄之魂]
你看起来像是这支队伍的首领。你需要去火炬处收集^0000FF10个战神的精魄^000000。

scripts.text:
[Ancient Hero's Soul]
Now I'll carve you the symbol which shows you're a inheritor of faith. Be aware that no one in your party but you can collect the Essence of Fire.
scripts.translation:
[远古英雄之魂]
现在我将为你刻下象征你是“信任的继承者”的印记。请注意，除了你之外，队伍中的其他人无法收集战神的精魄。

scripts.text:
[Ancient Hero's Soul]
You should also carry a ^0000FFToken of Apostle^000000, so find one for yourself too.
scripts.translation:
[远古英雄之魂]
你也应该携带一个^0000FF门徒的标示^000000，所以也要为自己找一个。

scripts.text:
[Ancient Hero's Soul]
When all of you are ready to go, let me know. I'll open the sealed gate when you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[远古英雄之魂]
当你们所有人都准备好时，告诉我。我会在那时打开封印之门。

scripts.text:
[Ancient Hero's Soul]
Make sure that your party leader has listened to my explanation of what you and your companions must do.
scripts.translation:
[远古英雄之魂]
请确保你的队伍首领已经听取了我关于你和同伴们必须做什么的解释。

scripts.text:
[Ancient Hero's Soul]
Kill the Apostles of Baphomet and find their ^0000FFToken of Apostle^000000.
scripts.translation:
[远古英雄之魂]
击杀巴风特的门徒并找到它们的^0000FF门徒的标示^000000。

scripts.text:
[Ancient Hero's Soul]
It might be better to kill all of them because there is no way to differentiate them from their clones.
scripts.translation:
[远古英雄之魂]
也许最好把它们全部击杀，因为没有其他方法将它们与克隆体区分开来。

scripts.text:
[Ancient Hero's Soul]
Are you ready?
Make sure that you have listened to all that I have to say before saying that you are ready.
scripts.translation:
[远古英雄之魂]
你准备好了吗？
在说准备好之前，请确保你已经听完了我要说的所有话。

scripts.text:
[Ancient Hero's Soul]
Are you ready to go? Then I'll open this sealed gate now.
scripts.translation:
[远古英雄之魂]
你们准备好出发了吗？那么我现在就打开这扇封印之门。

scripts.text:
[Ancient Hero's Soul]
It may be difficult but I wish you luck braving the perils of this catacomb.
scripts.translation:
[远古英雄之魂]
这可能很困难，但我祝你们在穿越这座地下墓穴的危险时好运。

scripts.text:
[Ancient Hero's Soul]
Remember, you need to collect ^0000FF10 Essence of Fire^000000 from the torches and the ^0000FFToken of Apostle^000000 from the Apostles of Baphomet.
scripts.translation:
[远古英雄之魂]
请记住，你们需要从火炬处收集^0000FF10个战神的精魄^000000，并从巴风特的门徒身上获取^0000FF门徒的标示^000000。

scripts.text:
[Ancient Hero's Soul]
To remind you again, I must be substantialized within the next hour. So everyone, finish your work within that time!
scripts.translation:
[远古英雄之魂]
再次提醒你们，我必须在下一小时内实体化。所以，大家请在这段时间内完成工作！

scripts.text:
[Ancient Hero's Soul]
To remind you again, I can be substantialized for the next hour. So everyone, finish your work within that time.
scripts.translation:
[远古英雄之魂]
再次提醒你们，我可以在接下来的一小时内实体化。所以，大家请在这段时间内完成工作。

scripts.text:
[Ancient Hero's Soul]
Did you get 10 ^0000FFEssence of Fire^000000 and ^0000FFToken of Apostle^000000?
scripts.translation:
[远古英雄之魂]
你们获得了10个^0000FF战神的精魄^000000和^0000FF门徒的标示^000000吗？

scripts.text:
[Ancient Hero's Soul]
Okay. You've done your work. Now check your companions and tell me when everyone has finished their work.
scripts.translation:
[远古英雄之魂]
好的。你们已经完成了工作。现在检查一下你的同伴，当所有人都完成工作时告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Ancient Hero's Soul]
Not ready yet? You should prepare 10 ^0000FFEssence of Fire^000000 and ^0000FFToken of Apostle^000000.
scripts.translation:
[远古英雄之魂]
还没准备好吗？你们应该准备10个^0000FF战神的精魄^000000和^0000FF门徒的标示^000000。

scripts.text:
[Ancient Hero's Soul]
Do you have a ^0000FFToken of Apostle^000000?
scripts.translation:
[远古英雄之魂]
你有^0000FF门徒的标示^000000吗？

scripts.text:
[Ancient Hero's Soul]
Okay. You've done your work. Tell your representative to check your companions and come to me when everyone has finished their work.
scripts.translation:
[远古英雄之魂]
好的。你们已经完成了工作。告诉你们的代表去检查同伴，等所有人都完成工作后再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Ancient Hero's Soul]
Not ready yet? You should prepare ^0000FFToken of Apostle^000000.
scripts.translation:
[远古英雄之魂]
还没准备好吗？你们应该准备^0000FF门徒的标示^000000。

scripts.text:
[Ancient Hero's Soul]
Are you ready? I opened the sealed gate. To pass the gate, you should carry a ^0000FFToken of Apostle^000000.
scripts.translation:
[远古英雄之魂]
准备好了吗？我已经打开了封印之门。要通过这道门，你们必须携带^0000FF门徒的标示^000000。

scripts.text:
[Ancient Hero's Soul]
Now you can go to the main altar. It is located in the bottom right corner of this floor.
scripts.translation:
[远古英雄之魂]
现在你们可以去主祭坛了。它位于这一层的右下角。

scripts.text:
[Ancient Hero's Soul]
Your real battle will begin... I'll follow you soon and find a way to help you.
scripts.translation:
[远古英雄之魂]
真正的战斗即将开始...我会尽快跟上你们，想办法帮你们。

scripts.text:
[Ancient Hero's Soul]
Go ahead, warriors.
scripts.translation:
[远古英雄之魂]
去吧，战士们。

scripts.text:
[Ancient Hero's Soul]
Are you ready? I opened the sealed gate. To pass the gate, you should carry a ^0000FFToken of Apostle^000000.
scripts.translation:
[远古英雄之魂]
准备好了吗？我已经打开了封印之门。要通过这道门，你们必须携带^0000FF门徒的标示^000000。

scripts.text:
[Ancient Hero's Soul]
I'll complete opening the sealed gate when your representative tells me that you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[远古英雄之魂]
当你们的代表告诉我你们准备好了，我就会完成封印之门的开启。

scripts.text:
[Ancient Hero's Soul]
What are you doing? The entrance of the main altar is opened now, go and fight! The entrance is near the bottom right side of this floor.
scripts.translation:
[远古英雄之魂]
你们在做什么？主祭坛的入口现在已经打开了，快去战斗吧！入口在这一层的右下方附近。

scripts.text:
[Ancient Hero's Soul]
I have nothing to say to you...
scripts.translation:
[远古英雄之魂]
我没什么话要对你们说的...

scripts.text:
[Ancient Hero's Soul]
Where is your Token of Apostle? I said you should carry the Token of Apostle to pass this gate.
scripts.translation:
[远古英雄之魂]
你的门徒的标示在哪里？我说过，要通过这道门必须携带门徒的标示。

scripts.text: A small object is shining under a leaning grave.
scripts.translation: 一块倾斜的墓碑下，有一个小物件在闪闪发光。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I think this is the pendant...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想这就是那个吊坠...

scripts.text: I can only feel gloom from this Gravestone.
scripts.translation: 我只能从这块墓碑上感受到阴森的气息。

scripts.text: I can only feel gloom from this Gravestone.
scripts.translation: 我只能从这块墓碑上感受到阴森的气息。

scripts.text: A huge torch appearing as if it can burn everything is bobbing up and down in front of me.
scripts.translation: 一团巨大的火炬在我面前上下浮动，仿佛能烧毁一切。

scripts.text: The grand appearance and heat of the fire makes me step back... But I pluck up my courage and reach out to pick up the torch.
scripts.translation: 火炬宏伟的外观和炽热的高温让我后退了一步...但我鼓起勇气，伸手去拿火炬。

scripts.text: The symbol of inheritor shines. Then a small crystal falls into my hand from the torch.
scripts.translation: 继承者的符号闪耀起来。随后，一颗小水晶从火炬中落入我的手中。

scripts.text: You have 10 Essence of Fire already, so you don't need to collect any more.
scripts.translation: 你已经拥有10个战神的精魄，不需要再收集了。

scripts.text: You don't need to collect Essence of Fire anymore.
scripts.translation: 你不需要再收集战神的精魄了。

scripts.text: A huge torch appearing as if it can burn everything is bobbing up and down in front of me..
scripts.translation: 一团巨大的火炬在我面前上下浮动，仿佛能烧毁一切。

scripts.text:
[Unknown Voice]
You are not a inheritor of faith. Do not desecrate the Essence of Fire with your disrespectful hands.
scripts.translation:
[未知的声音]
你并非信仰的继承者。不要用你那不敬的双手亵渎战神的精魄。

scripts.text: Your SP has not recovered yet. You lost your SP on the altar, but it seems the power of the seal has returned.
scripts.translation: 你的SP尚未恢复。你在祭坛上失去了SP，但封印的力量似乎已经回归。

scripts.text: I can feel the power of the altar came back by adding magical power.
scripts.translation: 我能感觉到，通过注入魔力，祭坛的力量正在恢复。

scripts.text: But you can't use your magic for 3 minutes because you used your SP on the altar.
scripts.translation: 但因为你将SP用在了祭坛上，3分钟内无法使用魔法。

scripts.text: An evil power, too terrible to describe, lies under the great altar radiating a violet color.
scripts.translation: 巨大的祭坛之下，潜伏着一股难以形容的邪恶力量，散发着紫色的光芒。

scripts.text: Complicated Magical Rune letters blink rapidly, attempting to suppress the dreadful power within.
scripts.translation: 复杂的魔法符文快速闪烁，试图压制其中可怕的力量。

scripts.text: The bottom of the Main Altar trembles furiously.
scripts.translation: 主祭坛的底部剧烈地颤抖着。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Watch out! Something... Something is coming.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
小心！有什么东西...有什么东西要来了。

scripts.text: An evil power, too terrible to describe, lies under the great altar radiating a violet color.
scripts.translation: 巨大的祭坛之下，潜伏着一股难以形容的邪恶力量，散发着紫色的光芒。

scripts.text: Complicated Magical Rune letters blink rapidly, attempting to suppress the dreadful power within.
scripts.translation: 复杂的魔法符文快速闪烁，试图压制其中可怕的力量。

scripts.text:
[Ancient Hero's Soul]
Good job, my descendants... You've finished the long-cherished task that me and my bretheren could not complete.
scripts.translation:
[远古英雄之魂]
干得好，我的后裔们...你们完成了我和兄弟们一直渴望却未能完成的任务。

scripts.text:
[Ancient Hero's Soul]
I really appreciate your help.
Our souls can finally rest in peace...
scripts.translation:
[远古英雄之魂]
我非常感激你们的帮助。
我们的灵魂终于可以安息了...

scripts.text:
[Ancient Hero's Soul]
The struggle for peace on this world will never end. But... my role here is finally over because there are brave heroes like you.
scripts.translation:
[远古英雄之魂]
这个世界对和平的争夺永远不会结束。但...因为有像你们这样勇敢的英雄，我在此的使命终于结束了。

scripts.text: Let me leave the shrine.
scripts.translation: 让我离开神龛

scripts.text: Stop talking.
scripts.translation: 别说了。

scripts.text:
[Ancient Hero's Soul]
Okay. I'll let you and your group leave here safely.
scripts.translation:
[远古英雄之魂]
好的。我会让你和你的队伍安全离开这里。

scripts.text:
[Ancient Hero's Soul]
If you leave, please say hello to Patrick for me.
scripts.translation:
[远古英雄之魂]
如果你要离开，请帮我向帕特里克问好。

scripts.text:
[Ancient Hero's Soul]
Do you still have something to do here? If you're done I'll let you leave safely...
scripts.translation:
[远古英雄之魂]
你还有事要做吗？如果结束了，我会让你安全离开...
